gloss: return gift; thank-you gift; reciprocal gift

definitions.gloss: return gift; thank-you gift; reciprocal gift
definitions.explanation: A gift given in return for a gift or favor received. Most commonly refers to the thank-you gifts sent by local governments to donors in the furusato nouzei (hometown tax) system.

examples.japanese: {返礼品|へんれいひん}を{選|えら}ぶ。
ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}の{返礼品|へんれいひん}で{和牛|わぎゅう}が{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: Wagyu beef arrived as a return gift from my hometown tax donation.

examples.japanese: {自治体|じちたい}は{魅力的|みりょくてき}な{返礼品|へんれいひん}を{用意|ようい}して{寄付|きふ}を{募|つの}っている。
examples.english: Local governments are soliciting donations by offering attractive return gifts.

notes:
Compound of {返礼|へんれい} (returning a courtesy, reciprocal gift) + {品|ひん} (item, product). While the word can refer to any reciprocal gift, it has become strongly associated with Japan's ふるさと{納税|のうぜい} (hometown tax donation) system.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In the ふるさと{納税|のうぜい} system, taxpayers can donate to any local government in Japan and receive tax deductions plus {返礼品|へんれいひん} — often local specialty products like premium beef, seafood, rice, or fruit. This system has become enormously popular, and browsing {返礼品|へんれいひん} catalogs is a common year-end activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ふるさと{納税|のうぜい}の{返礼品|へんれいひん} — hometown tax return gift
- {返礼品|へんれいひん}カタログ — return gift catalog
- {人気|にんき}の{返礼品|へんれいひん} — popular return gifts
- {返礼品|へんれいひん}を{受|う}け{取|と}る — to receive a return gift

SIMILAR WORDS:
- お{返|かえ}し — return gift (general, everyday term)
- {内祝|うちいわ}い — celebratory return gift (given in return for congratulatory gifts)
- {贈答品|ぞうとうひん} — gift item (broader, not specifically a return gift)
